svg.aria-label: Plan view of a dome showing the buried skirt ring, the airlocks and where a turned tunnel goes

g.text: Plan view: the footing is a closed ring, so a tunnel that meets it has only one way left, along the ring to the nearest airlock.
raiders dig in from outside this line
Arcology dome, 6 airlocks, skirt 60 ft deep
About 6-14 ft down, against concrete that runs 60 ft deep. The crew cannot go under it and finds no seam to
They follow the footing the short way round to the nearest airlock (red dashes), and a raid on that door
The airlock is the one opening
Two doors and a chamber. A crew that gets in meets the inner door held for about 22 s (a arcology dome).
Buried geophones ring the wall (teal dots). A set covers about 390 ft of wall, needs power, and hears a dig
The family's own tunnel and escape route pass through the airlock marked A, and nowhere else (teal dashes),
in a sleeve through the footing.
THE SAME RING AT THE OTHER TIERS
